meta.name: handoff
meta.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把对话压缩成交接文档,让下一个智能体顺利接手。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在多个智能体之间接力完成任务。
copy.tagline_en: Compress the conversation into a handoff doc for the next agent.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to hand off context between agents in a multi-step task.

howto.what: 使用此技能后，Claude 会把当前对话整理成一份交接文档，保存到电脑临时目录，方便新对话继续处理。文档包含建议调用的技能，并移除 API 密钥等敏感内容，只引用已有文件路径。
howto.when: 当用户要求为另一代理生成交接文档、以延续当前对话时触发；提供参数时，文档会按参数描述下一会话的重点。

say.text: 生成交接文档，让新会话接着处理客户邮件。
say.note: 文档保存到临时目录并隐藏敏感信息。

say.text: 整理当前对话为交接文档，重点说明下一步要修复的 bug。
say.note: 参数会写入文档开头，指导新会话重点。

say.text: 生成交接文档，建议新会话调用报表技能。
say.note: 文档会列出推荐的技能。

howto.what_en: Claude summarizes the current conversation into a handoff document saved to the OS temp directory, for a new session to continue. It lists suggested skills, references existing files instead of duplicating, and removes sensitive data.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create a handoff document for another agent from the current conversation. If arguments are passed, they tailor the document to the next session's focus.

say_en.text: Create a handoff doc so a new session can handle client emails.
say_en.note: Saved to temp dir with sensitive info redacted.

say_en.text: Summarize this chat into a handoff doc, focusing on the next bug fix.
Make a handoff doc that suggests the reporting skill.
say_en.note: The doc will list recommended skills.
